definitions.explanation: A condition where distant objects appear blurry because the eye focuses images in front of the retina rather than on it. Also used to refer to a person who is nearsighted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{近眼|きんがん}です。
{近眼|きんがん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどくて→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧、メガネなし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}できない→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: My nearsightedness is so bad that I can't get by without glasses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦やり→やる：02980_yaru⟧すぎで{近眼|きんがん}になってしまった。
examples.english: I became nearsighted from playing too many video games since childhood.

notes:
Composed of {近|きん} (near) + {眼|がん} (eye). A common everyday word, especially relevant in Japan where myopia rates are among the highest in the world.

ALTERNATIVE READING:
Also read as きんめ in older or dialectal usage, though きんがん is standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近眼|きんがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become nearsighted
- {近眼|きんがん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧: to have bad nearsightedness
- {近眼|きんがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a nearsighted person
- {近眼|きんがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{矯正|きょうせい}→矯正：14784_kyousei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to correct nearsightedness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{近視|きんし}→近視：02683_kinshi⟧: myopia — the more technical/medical synonym, used in formal contexts
- ⟦{遠視|えんし}→遠視：07105_enshi⟧: farsightedness — the opposite condition
- ⟦{乱視|らんし}→乱視：06370_ranshi⟧: astigmatism — another common vision condition
